worldcombat.skill.rocksmash.summary: Throw a quick flurry of point-blank punches at the hardest part of the foe: each jab deals a little contact damage, and if any of them lands the set may crack the target's Defence down a stage. Fast to throw and quick to come back, so it is the cheap way to wear a guard down.
The flurry throws %2$s jabs, each dealing %1$s contact damage.
Punch reach is about %1$s blocks with a %2$s block hit radius.
If any jab in the set lands, a %1$s chance lowers the target's Defence by %2$s stage; the drop does not heal when the mark ends. The cracked mark lasts %3$s, and other guard-breaking moves read it.
worldcombat.skill.rocksmash.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.rocksmash.growth.0: From level %1$s the single jab rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.rocksmash.growth.1: From level %1$s the crack chance rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.rocksmash.use.0: Chip a guard down at point-blank
worldcombat.skill.rocksmash.use.1: Wear a foe down with cheap rapid hits
worldcombat.skill.rocksmash.use.2: Crack the guard open before a heavy blow
worldcombat.skill.rocksmash.preference.a: Beyond this distance it closes in instead of punching. Larger values start the flurry from further out.
On: prefer targets that do not carry the guardbroken identity yet, to open the guard first. Off: treat it as an ordinary close attack.
